name: Synchronized Action Checklist Motion Clip
description: A focused wide-format b-roll animation for showing a short publishing workflow moving from pending to complete in one controlled visual rhythm. It is built for social creators and educators who need polished, editable motion without a generation model.
whatYouGet: Wide HTML/CSS composition rendered to a local MP4
Synchronized checklist reveal and completion motion
Minimal dark editorial styling with one accent color
Editable copy, timing, rows, and palette values
goodFit: Social posts explaining a repeatable publishing routine
Educational clips that turn process steps into visual rhythm
Series content that needs a consistent motion language
notFor: Brand campaigns requiring logos or licensed visual assets
requiredInputs: Two to four short publishing actions
Target social channel or crop context

faq.q: Can I change the checklist copy after rendering?
faq.a: Yes. The deliverable keeps the action labels, timing, accent color, and closing line in editable HTML and CSS so the same motion system can be reused.

faq.q: Does this use a video generation model?
faq.a: No. The agent builds a deterministic HTML/CSS composition and renders the MP4 locally, which keeps the output consistent and easy to revise.

faq.q: How many actions should the clip contain?
faq.a: Two to four short actions work best. Each line should describe one observable publishing task and remain concise enough to scan during the final hold.

demoPrompt: /sl-synchronized-action-checklist-motion-clip Create a 9-second 16:9 video for Publishing rhythm. Open with “PUBLISH WITH INTENT”; show the Release rhythm checklist, then “Everything aligned” with READY, and close with “Small checks. Stronger releases.” Keep the dark editorial blocks and synchronized timing, with one acid-lime accent.
followUpPrompts: Change the checklist to a three-step lesson planning workflow while preserving the timing and visual system.
Make the final hold longer and replace the closing line with "Small checks. Stronger releases."
externalCostNote: No external services or generation models. Renders locally.
